I have farmed this land for many years and know that tubers grow well here with manure from my livestock, so I do not buy chemical fertilizer which is too costly for root crops. I keep my own seed yams and cassava cuttings from the last harvest because they are reliable, and the family will do most of the work ourselves, but I will hire a few young men for the heaviest days during land preparation and harvest.
